resources.string: SwiftSense is fully open-source. Your privacy is my priority, which is why the app never connects to the internet. All your data stays safely on your device.
I\'ve gathered tools to optimize sensor rates and improve touch response in one place. Let\'s see what your hardware is truly capable of.
To give you the best performance, I need a few permissions. Don\'t worry, I only ask for what\'s absolutely necessary.
Required so I can work smoothly in the background and keep you updated on the status.
We don\'t want the system to slow SwiftSense down. I recommend removing battery restrictions for the best experience.

Prevents screen burn-in and limits static pixels using a subtle overlay mesh.
Applies an overlay pixel mesh to prevent screen burn-in extending the lifespan of AMOLED displays.

This service is used ONLY to draw a protective pixel overlay on your screen to prevent AMOLED burn-in. It DOES NOT collect, store or transmit any of your personal data, screen content, or keystrokes. It only requires overlay permission to extend your display\'s lifespan.

Fast filter movements (less than 1 minute) or very high pixel density may cause eye fatigue or discomfort during prolonged use. For the best experience, we recommend using durations of 1 minute or longer.
